dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: Greetings. I'm Deyou, a merchant from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, are you here to purchase potions, too?

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: That's right. Your store's doing pretty well, so I'm sure my sales will be good this time... Yeah, very sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey now, our potions are selling super well — orders just keep pouring in, we can barely cope!

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: My apologies. I'm not doubting your sales figures...

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: It's my business that hasn't been going too well. Every time I buy popular products, they just don't sell before prices go down all around — I post losses nine out of ten times.

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: I always convince myself it's just bad luck, but if I have nothing but bad luck, does that mean that I'm just... not cut out for this...?

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: If I don't make any money this time, I'll pack up, head home, and just work for my father.

choices.text: Maybe you're just choosing the wrong products?

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Is that so...? I suppose there's still much for me to learn.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Right. You're right. I can't stay down like this. I'll make money this time — and I'll impress my father, make him see what I'm made of...

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Okay! Down to business. Let's talk terms.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: These are the types of potion I plan to purchase this time.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Don't worry. Caution is the better part of valor — and business.

choices.text: Perhaps the issue is with your sales strategy.
